verdict.rationale: Docs show block/page tagging (`#Page`) and a property-like syntax example (`publish:: true`), plus `[[ ]]`/`(( ))` references and `{{query}}` for retrieval across the knowledge base, supporting organization-and-retrieval workflows. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of a general typed-properties system (e.g., date/number/checkbox property types) or examples of querying by custom properties, and no community evidence confirms this works consistently at scale. Missing for 10: dedicated properties/typed-metadata documentation, examples of property-based queries, and independent user confirmation of consistent retrieval via properties/tags.
